primaryOutcome.name: blinded paired design-quality score
primaryOutcome.affirmativeRule: one-sided 95 percent paired-bootstrap lower bound strictly greater than -5 within each task

analysis.multiplicity: Holm correction across task-level secondary tests
analysis.missingData: no imputation; every failure and exclusion is reported
analysis.dollarCost: not estimated without measured billing data

grading.label: model-graded; not independent human practitioner evidence
grading.aggregation: panel median per rubric dimension and total

releaseClaimPolicy: No superiority claim is permitted unless its corresponding preregistered gate passes.
